faculty.name: Nikki Arrington
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain changes during reading acquisition and uses neuroimaging and neuromodulation to help individuals with dyslexia.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究阅读习得过程中大脑的变化，并使用神经成像和神经调节技术帮助阅读障碍患者。

faculty.name: Matthew Birnie
faculty.summary: Studies how early-life stress reprograms neural circuits affecting cognition and mood, using mouse models and optogenetics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究早期生活应激如何重新编程神经环路影响认知和情绪，使用小鼠模型和光遗传学方法。

faculty.name: David Braithwaite
faculty.summary: Studies logical reasoning and mathematical thinking, using behavioral studies and computational modeling to improve education.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究逻辑推理和数学思维，使用行为研究和计算建模来改进教育。

faculty.name: Sarah Brown
faculty.summary: Studies the development of suicidal ideation and behaviors, using experimental therapeutics and multi-method approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究自杀意念和行为的发展，采用实验治疗学和多方法学方法。

faculty.name: Jordan Burko Macatee
faculty.summary: Supports graduate students' clinical training and supervision in evidence-based treatments like CBT and DBT.
faculty.summary_zh: 支持临床心理学研究生的临床培训和督导，提供基于证据的治疗方法如认知行为疗法和辩证行为疗法。

faculty.name: Corinne Carlton-Smith
faculty.summary: Studies the development of anhedonia and internalizing symptoms in youth using neuroscience techniques and clinical interventions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究青少年的欣快感缺失和内部化症状的发展，采用神经科学技术和临床干预方法。

faculty.name: Jesse Cougle
faculty.summary: Studies technology-based treatments for anxiety disorders, obsessive-compulsive and related disorders, and problematic anger, using randomized controlled trials and web-based interventions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究焦虑障碍、强迫症及相关障碍和技术干预治疗，使用随机对照试验和网络干预方法。

faculty.name: Adam Dewan
faculty.summary: Studies the molecular and cellular basis of olfactory perception in mice using genetic, optogenetic, and behavioral techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究嗅觉感知的分子和细胞基础，使用遗传学、光遗传学和行为技术在小鼠中进行探索。

faculty.name: Lisa Eckel
faculty.summary: Studies the physiological and neural mechanisms of ingestive behavior, particularly the effects of estradiol on food intake and body weight in female rodents.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究雌激素对雌性啮齿动物摄食行为的生理和神经机制，特别是对食物摄入和体重的影响。

faculty.name: Colleen Ganley
faculty.summary: Studies factors affecting students' math learning and STEM career interests, focusing on math anxiety, spatial skills, and working memory.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究影响学生数学学习和STEM职业兴趣的因素，重点关注数学焦虑、空间技能和工作记忆。

faculty.name: Elizabeth Hammock
faculty.summary: Studies the neurobiological mechanisms of social and affective behaviors in mammals, focusing on oxytocin and vasopressin during post-natal development.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究哺乳动物的社会和情感行为的神经生物学机制，重点关注产后发育期间的催产素和血管加压素的作用。

faculty.name: Tiffany Hardy
faculty.summary: Manages administrative tasks in the psychology department, including course scheduling and student support.
faculty.summary_zh: 管理心理学系的行政事务，包括课程安排和学生支持。

faculty.name: Sherelle Harmon
faculty.summary: Studies the development and treatment of emotional and behavioral dysregulation in youth, focusing on neurocognitive processes and anger regulation.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童和青少年情绪和行为失调的发展和治疗方法，重点关注神经认知过程和愤怒调节。

faculty.name: Rasheda Haughbrook
faculty.summary: Studies the intersection of environment, genetics, and context on academic and health outcomes, using statistical modeling and secondary data analyses.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究环境、基因和背景对学业和健康结果的影响，使用统计建模和二次数据分析方法。

faculty.name: Molly S. Hermiller
faculty.summary: Studies the spatial and temporal dynamics of the human brain supporting cognition, particularly how the hippocampus interacts with other brain regions to form, consolidate, and retrieve episodic.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究支持认知的脑部空间和时间动态，特别是海马体与其他脑区如何交互以形成、巩固和检索情景记忆。

faculty.name: Thomas Joiner
faculty.summary: Studies the interpersonal theory of suicide, focusing on causes, correlates, and prevention of suicidal behavior in various settings.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究自杀的人际理论，关注自杀行为的原因、相关因素及其在不同环境中的预防。

faculty.name: Michael Kaschak
faculty.summary: Studies how social and cognitive factors influence language production and comprehension, focusing on perception and action planning.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会和认知因素如何影响语言生产和理解，重点关注知觉和动作规划系统的作用。

faculty.name: Pamela Keel
faculty.summary: Studies biological and psychological factors contributing to binge eating and purging behaviors, using longitudinal and epidemiological methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究暴饮暴食和呕吐行为的生物学和心理因素，使用纵向和流行病学方法。

faculty.name: Therese Kemper
faculty.summary: Provides clinical supervision and training for clinical psychology graduate students, focusing on Motivational Interviewing.
faculty.summary_zh: 为临床心理学研究生提供临床督导和培训，重点是动机访谈。

faculty.name: Shin Kira
faculty.summary: Studies how brain circuits enable flexible behavior through generalization, using behavioral paradigms, neural recording, and computational modeling in mice.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑电路如何通过泛化促进灵活行为，使用行为范式、神经记录和计算建模方法在小鼠中进行研究。

faculty.name: Michael Kofler
faculty.summary: Studies the neurocognitive factors of ADHD, focusing on working memory and developing strengths-based interventions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究ADHD的认知神经因素，特别是工作记忆，并开发基于优势的干预措施。

faculty.name: Callie Little
faculty.summary: Studies how child-specific factors such as genetic influences interact with environmental contexts to shape reading development, using geospatial analyses and risk-resilience models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究遗传因素和环境因素如何相互作用影响儿童阅读发展，使用地理空间分析和风险-韧性模型。

faculty.name: Yan Liu
faculty.summary: Studies social attachment and reward interactions in prairie voles using neurobiology and behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究草原田鼠的社会依附和奖励相互作用，采用神经生物学和行为实验方法。

faculty.name: Christopher Lonigan
faculty.summary: Studies the affective basis of psychopathology and the development of language and literacy skills in preschool children, examining their interplay with self-regulation and social development.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究情绪对心理障碍发展的影响以及学龄前儿童语言和阅读技能的发展，探讨这些技能与自我调节和社会发展之间的相互作用。

faculty.name: Rick Macatee
faculty.summary: Studies co-occurring mood/anxiety and substance use disorders, particularly cannabis use disorder, using EEG/ERP methods and digital technology for assessment and treatment.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究共病情绪/焦虑障碍和物质使用障碍，特别是大麻使用障碍，使用EEG/ERP方法和数字技术进行评估和治疗。

faculty.name: Heath M. Maranges
faculty.summary: Studies factors that facilitate cooperation and moral decision-making, including developmental environments, traits, and perceptual processes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究促进合作和道德决策的因素，包括发展环境、特质和知觉过程。

faculty.name: David S. March
faculty.summary: Studies how automatic processes shape social perception and response to threat, using behavioral experiments, computational modeling, and virtual reality.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究自动过程如何塑造人们对威胁的社会感知和反应，使用行为实验、计算建模和虚拟现实技术。

faculty.name: Chris Martin
faculty.summary: Studies the cognitive and neural bases of human memory using fMRI, EEG, eye tracking, and cognitive behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类记忆的认知和神经基础，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、脑电图（EEG）、眼动追踪和认知行为实验。

faculty.name: Jim McNulty
faculty.summary: Studies how strong beliefs in close relationships change or remain stable over time, focusing on marital satisfaction and forgiveness.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究亲密关系中强烈信念的变化或稳定性，重点关注婚姻满意度和原谅。

faculty.name: Andrea Meltzer
faculty.summary: Studies how personal qualities and intimate relationships influence each other, using evolutionary and longitudinal methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究个人特质和亲密关系如何相互影响，采用进化论和纵向研究方法。

faculty.name: Andrew Moberly
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain processes sensory information in real time using in vivo calcium imaging in mice.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何实时处理感官信息，使用小鼠体内钙成像技术。

faculty.name: Derek Nee
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of cognitive control and working memory using fMRI and TMS, examining how the prefrontal cortex guides behavior and the role of sub-cortical areas.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用功能性磁共振成像(fMRI)和经颅磁刺激(TMS)研究认知控制和工作记忆的神经机制，探讨前额叶皮层如何引导行为以及下皮层区域的作用。

faculty.name: Tehila Nugiel
faculty.summary: Studies brain function in children with learning challenges and ADHD using fMRI and network science to improve academic and mental health outcomes.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用功能性磁共振成像和网络科学研究患有学习障碍和 ADHD 的儿童的大脑功能，以改善学业和心理健康结果。

faculty.name: Irmak Olcaysoy Okten
faculty.summary: Studies how people form and update implicit and explicit impressions and beliefs, focusing on the role of motivational factors like reducing uncertainty and preserving ideological convictions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们如何形成和更新显性和隐性的印象和信念，重点关注减少不确定性动机和维护意识形态信念的作用。

faculty.name: Ashby Plant
faculty.summary: Studies how people's motivations affect intergroup attitudes, emotions, and behavior, focusing on reducing intergroup tension.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究动机如何影响群体态度、情绪和行为，以减少群体间的紧张关系。

faculty.name: Justin Riddle
faculty.summary: Studies how electrical brain activity supports cognitive control and its disruption in psychiatric illness, using EEG, fMRI, TMS, and tACS.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑电活动如何支持认知控制及其在精神疾病中的中断，使用EEG、fMRI、TMS和tACS。

faculty.name: Alireza Salami
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of cognitive decline in aging, focusing on episodic memory, using fMRI and PET.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究衰老过程中认知衰退的神经机制，重点是情景记忆，使用功能性磁共振成像和正电子发射断层扫描。

faculty.name: Chris Schatschneider
faculty.summary: Studies individual differences in reading skill development, identifying at-risk children and using statistical methods like hierarchical linear modeling.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究阅读技能发展的个体差异，识别有阅读障碍风险的儿童，并使用分层线性建模等统计方法。

faculty.name: James Sullivan
faculty.summary: Teaches undergraduate psychology courses.
faculty.summary_zh: 教授本科心理学课程。

faculty.name: Carmen Varela
faculty.summary: Studies the cellular and network mechanisms of thalamic cells and their role in learning and memory, particularly during sleep.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究丘脑细胞和网络机制及其在学习和记忆中的作用，特别是在睡眠过程中的作用。

faculty.name: Rick Wagner
faculty.summary: Studies dyslexia and reading acquisition, focusing on assessment and cognitive foundations.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究阅读障碍和阅读获得，重点关注评估和认知基础。

faculty.name: Teion Wells Harrison
faculty.summary: Trains psychology students and teaches courses on psychology and law, child development, and assessment.
faculty.summary_zh: 培训心理学研究生并教授心理学与法律、儿童发展和评估课程。

faculty.name: Aaron Wilber
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain network for spatial learning and memory is altered by mental disorders and age-related cognitive disorders, using rodent models and behavioral tasks.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究与空间学习和记忆相关的脑网络如何因精神疾病和年龄相关认知障碍而改变，使用啮齿动物模型和行为任务。
